summary: Boom-bap hip hop: 80–95 BPM, swung, sampled-sounding keys on 7th chords, punchy kick and snare
body: Drums: pattern/boombap-1, swung 8th hats; kick and snare loud and dry.
Harmony: 7th and 9th chords on keys (Rhodes, a sampled piano), two-chord vamps or ii–V–I.
Bass: round, roots on the downbeat, following the kick.
With production/lofi it becomes lofi hip hop (70–90 BPM, softer, darker).
Apply: pattern/boombap-1 on the drums, then pattern/lofi-vamp-vi-iv on the keys four bars later. Tempo and sounds are left to you.
